operations.build: Build one remote package or local PKGBUILD root without saving a preference
operations.upgrade: Update the system and rebuild configured source packages
operations.upgrade-all: Update the system, registered source packages, and remaining installed AUR packages
operations.deps: Classify AUR dependencies for one or more packages
operations.plan: Show the AUR build-order plan for one or more packages
operations.fetch: Fetch AUR build repositories without updating working trees
operations.add-src: Enable source-build preferences for one or more items
operations.del-src: Remove one or more source-build preferences
operations.revert: Remove preferences and reinstall binary packages
operations.edit-src: Edit one or more source-build preferences
operations.-G: Export one AUR PackageBase repository without building or installing
operations.-Gp: Print one AUR PackageBase PKGBUILD without keeping a checkout

options.-h: Show the help message and exit
options.--help: Show the help message and exit
options.--dry-run: Observe a supported mutating operation without changing persistent state
options.--edit: Open or edit PKGBUILD and .install files for this invocation
options.--diff: Review changes from the previous reviewed revision to the exact target
options.--nodiff: Skip reviewed source changes without advancing reviewed state
options.--noconfirm: Skip prompts on supported routes; forwarding remains route-owned
options.--rmdeps: Unsupported for separated source builds; no dependency cleanup is performed
options.--local: Use one local PKGBUILD directory as the build root
options.--output-dir: Select an existing export parent for -G
options.--select: Interactively select source-aware package candidates for plain -S
options.--aur: Limit supported sync operations to AUR
options.--repo: Limit supported sync operations to official binary repositories
options.--needed: Skip reinstall at final package installation
